partnership_angle: Referral partner (validator-tier). Linford is too established for a design-partner feeder role — founded 2008, 18 partners, every engagement staffed with 10+ year auditors — but that seniority is exactly what makes their validation valuable. They are already in the Drata Audit Alliance, so they understand and embrace automation-assisted audits, and they publish startup readiness content that a LoxeAI pre-audit scan slots directly into. Entry motion: get one partner (Isaac Clarke, whose bio leads with startups, or co-founder Nicole Hemmer) to sandbox-test the scan, then have them recommend it to inbound startup prospects who aren't audit-ready yet. Caveats: headcount hovers right at the ~40 line and the firm serves clients up to Fortune 500, so startup work is a segment, not the whole book.
pitch_note: You wrote the readiness-hacks playbook that half the startup ecosystem reads before their first SOC 2 — LoxeAI turns that playbook into an automated AWS scan. I'd love 30 minutes to have one of your partners run it against a sandbox AWS account and tear it apart; if it holds up to your 10-years-minimum auditor bar, it becomes something you hand to pre-audit startups: 'run this scan first — it gets you 80% ready before we ever start fieldwork.' No cost, no integration lift — you validate it, your early-stage pipeline shows up cleaner, and your team spends fieldwork on judgment instead of missing MFA screenshots.
